local.title: Local Community Development & Empowerment
local.tagline: Empowering Individuals. Supporting Youth. Strengthening Communities.
intro: LDII is committed to improving livelihoods, empowering individuals, supporting youth development, and strengthening communities through inclusive, community-based programmes.

Our current local programme focus is Ontario, Canada, with a vision for future expansion throughout Canada. Through partnerships with community organizations, educational institutions, government agencies, police services, businesses and other stakeholders, we seek to address social and economic challenges while building stronger, safer, and more resilient communities.

programmes.title: Newcomer Settlement, Integration & Housing Support
programmes.tagline: Welcoming Newcomers. Supporting Integration. Building Stable Communities.
programmes.summary: We help newcomers, youth and immigrant families build confidence, access essential information, and participate meaningfully in Canadian society, because successful settlement also requires stable housing, social connections, educational opportunities and supportive communities.
bullets: Community integration and access to community services
Settlement partnerships with agencies, schools and service providers
programmes.imageAlt: Community members gathered at the LDII offices in Toronto

programmes.title: Youth Employment, Career Development & Economic Empowerment
programmes.tagline: Developing Skills. Expanding Opportunities. Building Economic Independence.
programmes.summary: We equip young people with the knowledge, confidence and practical skills to succeed in education, employment, entrepreneurship and community leadership.
bullets: Employment readiness and career development: job search, résumés, interviews, workplace readiness
Youth leadership, mentorship and professional networking
Partnerships with colleges, universities, employers and training institutions
programmes.imageAlt: Two students in school blazers with LDII hosts

programmes.title: Youth Development, Community Safety & Crime Prevention
programmes.tagline: Empowering Youth. Preventing Crime. Building Safer Communities.
programmes.summary: Effective crime prevention begins with education, mentorship, positive youth engagement and access to meaningful opportunities. We work with youth, families, schools, police services and community organizations to build safer, more inclusive neighbourhoods across Ontario.
bullets: Positive youth development, mentorship and guidance

programmes.title: Youth Education, Mental Health & Social Inclusion
programmes.tagline: Promoting Wellbeing. Expanding Knowledge. Building Inclusive Communities.
programmes.summary: Education, supportive relationships and community engagement can reduce social isolation, address mental health stigma and create opportunities for meaningful participation.
bullets: Mental health awareness, education and stigma reduction
Partnerships with schools, mental health organizations and youth-serving agencies
programmes.imageAlt: Participants in conversation around a table

programmes.tagline: Connecting Organizations. Strengthening Partnerships. Advancing Community Development.
programmes.summary: LDII brings together community organizations, educational institutions, government agencies, businesses and development partners to identify shared priorities and explore collaborative solutions to local challenges.
bullets: Collaboration with universities, colleges and research institutions
programmes.imageAlt: Community partners in Brampton with a certificate of recognition

programmes.title: Seniors’ Support, Wellbeing & Social Inclusion
programmes.tagline: Supporting Seniors. Promoting Dignity. Strengthening Community Connections.
programmes.summary: Many older adults face social isolation, limited access to information and digital exclusion. We promote seniors’ wellbeing, dignity, independence and meaningful participation in community life.
bullets: Digital literacy and computer training for seniors
Partnerships with seniors’ organizations and community centres

newcomer.title: Newcomer Settlement & Integration Programme
newcomer.closing: Supporting New Beginnings. Empowering Newcomers. Strengthening Communities.

areas.title: Settlement Orientation & Information
areas.text: Helping newcomers understand essential aspects of life in Canada, including public services, community resources, Canadian institutions, and everyday responsibilities.

areas.title: Community Integration & Social Inclusion
areas.text: Encouraging newcomers to establish social connections, participate in community activities, develop a sense of belonging, and build supportive relationships.

areas.title: Employment & Career Pathway Information
areas.text: Providing information about Canadian employment systems, job-search resources, workplace expectations, professional development opportunities, and relevant employment support organizations.

areas.title: Housing Information & Community Resources
areas.text: Helping newcomers understand housing-related information, tenant rights and responsibilities, available housing resources, and appropriate sources of assistance.

areas.title: Financial Literacy & Banking Awareness
areas.text: Promoting understanding of Canadian banking systems, budgeting, saving, credit, and responsible financial decision-making.

areas.title: Access to Community Services
areas.text: Helping newcomers identify relevant community organizations and resources related to healthcare, education, language learning, settlement services, and family support.

areas.title: Cultural Orientation & Community Participation
areas.text: Promoting awareness of Canadian cultural diversity, civic responsibilities, community engagement, mutual respect, and peaceful coexistence.

areas.title: Personal Development & Community Empowerment
areas.text: Encouraging newcomers to develop confidence, practical knowledge, leadership potential, and the skills needed to participate meaningfully in their communities.

beneficiaries: Newly arrived immigrants and permanent residents
Internationally trained professionals navigating settlement and workforce integration
Individuals experiencing barriers to social and economic integration
newcomer.eligibility: Eligibility for particular activities may depend on programme requirements and available resources.
approach: LDII recognizes that successful settlement requires more than access to information. It involves developing confidence, building relationships, understanding available opportunities, and participating actively in community life.

Our approach emphasizes community education, practical guidance, information sharing, capacity building, and collaboration with relevant community organizations and service providers. We seek to help newcomers overcome settlement barriers while encouraging independence, inclusion, and long-term community participation.
newcomer.commitment: At LDII, we believe every newcomer deserves the opportunity to feel welcomed, informed, supported, and empowered, and to develop their potential, establish meaningful connections, and contribute to Canada’s social and economic development.
